newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: OPTIONS -- EOE TURNOVER SUBDUED BY UK HOLIDAY.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS -- EOE TURNOVER SUBDUED BY UK HOLIDAY.

text.p: Trade was subdued on the European Options Exchange (EOE) on Monday as the UK market holiday and the absence of any significant data from the United States took its toll on activity.
Turnover amounted to just below 50,000 contracts by late afternoon, well down on normal levels. The AEX contract option was the most active as usual, taking 12.5 percent of the total.

BolsWessanen turnover was high at 3,120 calls and 357 puts ahead of the company's first half results. Dealers noted active call buying from investors looking for a better-than-expected results on Wednesday. -- Amsterdam newsdesk +31 20 504 5000
